scope: Canonical/scalar/raw-row, named binding mutations and production HTTP/job state scenarios; live and cross-runtime acceptance remain separately required
reference_encoder: ECMAScript JSON.stringify and UTF-16 Array.sort; raw strings preserved
unicode_scalar_boundary: Reject malformed UTF-8 direct Go strings; JS direct strings reject unpaired UTF-16 surrogates. scalar-bytes vectors contain invalid UTF-8 hex and must be rejected before scalar success, never decoded with replacement.
float64_input_match: Entire input must match, including its final code unit. JavaScript implementations must verify match length, because $ can match before a final newline.

http_scenario_protocol.request: fixed origin + exact method/path/query; full JSON request body compared canonically
http_scenario_protocol.response: literal body or body_hex preserved before parsing; gzip means harness-compressed UTF-8 body; advance_ms advances injected clock before response
http_scenario_protocol.actions: Trusted test controls change grant/principal/policy/clock or persisted bounds. Rebind preserves original principal/counters/deadline and rotates active cursor. No production request may carry these controls.
http_scenario_protocol.overflow_observations: Only explicit expected_runtime_observations.go/js.bytes on rejected overflow scenarios may differ according to actual exposed decompressed chunks; all other report fields/counters remain equal. response_chunk_bytes controls identical read schedules in the harness.
